newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Texas A&M University.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Texas A&M University.

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Board of Regents of The Texas A&M University System, c/o Rick Porter, McCall, Parkhurst & Horton L.L.P., 717 North Harwood, Suite 900, Dallas, Texas 75201-6587, on Tuesday,

until 9:30 A.M., Central Daylight Time, and then publicly opened, for the purchase of $35,000,000 of Board of Regents of The Texas A&M University System Permanent University Fund Subordinate Lien Notes, Series B.

The installment of the Notes is anticipated to be delivered to the Purchaser on June 3, 1997. The Current Installment will bear interest at the rate of interest named by the Purchaser from the date of initial delivery of the Notes until June 6, 1997 (the Mandatory Tender Date''). On the Mandatory Tender Date, the Current Installment is subject to mandatory tender for purchase at a purchase price equal to the principal amount thereof plus accrued interest from the date of initial delivery thereof.
